summary: Container apps in the one-click installer: Ghost, Nextcloud, Uptime Kuma, n8n, Gitea, Plausible and Jellyfin, on private networks with loopback-only ports via guarded agent verbs (KD-040). App backup and restore with in-container database dumps; S3 provider presets with a live test (KD-043). App health alerts (KD-042), OS package updates and an in-panel update notice (KD-041). Migrations 0010-0012 are additive: app_port, app health tables, restore_points.manifest.
